messages:
nina-sales: Heads-up — TrustFin wants an on-prem air-gapped POC. Requirements: signed incremental patches, no outbound network calls during install, documented rollback, and explicit key delivery method.

omar-solutions: Confirmed. Two options for signing: customer HSM (they hold private key) or our signed bundles with an attestation record. Need to know if they want minibundle diffs or full-image swaps.

kelly-sr-eng: We prefer minibundles for bandwidth and quicker rollbacks. Format: chunked cpio + manifest + signature. Apply is offline only. We include a verify script that checks manifest sig + checksums.

raj-security: Security constraints: must support customer-managed signing and provide a key-wrapping/runbook for sneakernet transfer. Also provide FIPS-validated options if required. One-liner for questionnaire: "Yes — Redwood supports customer-managed HSM/KMS signing for offline bundles; see attached key-injection runbook."

peter-ops: For transfer resiliency: suggest encrypted minibundles (AES-256) with envelope keys delivered via sealed USB or wrapped with their KMS pubkey. Use `rsync --partial` for large transfers and include `.part` retry steps in runbook.

omar-solutions: Pricing notes: POC support (2w eng + validation) ~ $32k. Offline subscription (4 signed deltas/yr + emergency hotfix SLA) ~ $21k/year. HSM integration/setup ~ $7k one-time.

nina-sales: Great. @ticket-bot please open POC ticket TrustFin-offline with tags: airgap, customer-hsm, minibundle-deltas.

ticket-bot: Created POC-TRUST-2026-42. Assigned to kelly-sr-eng. ETA: initial artifact in 6 business days.

kelly-sr-eng: I'll add specimen `bundle.sha256`, `manifest.json`, and a minimal verify.sh to the ticket. No telemetry included by default.

nina-sales: I'll update the SOW and the security questionnaire answers; will circle back if procurement asks for encrypted delivery details. Thanks all :thumbsup:
